programme.title: Plainfield TV
programme.desc:
Welcome to Plainfield TV. We showcase programs produced in-house by Jeslinfield Productions.
**Programs we play here:** - Are You Smarter Than A 5th Grader - Bigjon's Wheel of Fortune - Deal Or No Deal LIVE - The Downers Grove Railfanning Series - The High Rollers Big Numbers Bonus Game: The Series - Meal or No Meal - Nostalgia Paradise - Play Nine; The Series - Sorry CD-ROM The Series - Street Viewing Chicagoland On Apple Maps - The Bowling Train - Ticket To Ride The Series - Tower of Cash - Wheel of Fortune 2nd Edition LIVE - Yahtzee CD-ROM: The Series
New episodes of these shows air every weekday in a block we call "The New Program Showcase". Airtimes for this as well as the shows that will air during it will be listed in the Programming Updates section on this page.
**Live shows we run**
| Show | Airtime (In Central Time) | | ------ | ------ | | Ticket To Ride Live | 7 PM Sunday | | Roblox Live (To Be Retired) | 6 PM Tuesday | | Weekly Test Wednesday Live | 8:15 AM Wednesday | | Backyard Baseball Live | 5 PM Thursday | | Friday Fun Night Show | 7 PM Friday | | Weekend Fun & Games Show | 3 PM Saturday |
**What we feature during our live shows**
In addition to the usual game(s) that are part of the program, we also feature various other games to fill in the runtime. On the Friday Fun Night Show, we feature Bigjon's Deal or No Deal, Set for Life, and Wheel of Fortune, as well as the Sorry! PC game. On the Weekend Fun & Games Show, we feature The Game of Life, the Play Nine mobile app, and Sorry!, in addition to Bigjon's Wheel of Fortune On the 2 Aformationed shows as well as the Weekly Test Wednesday Live show (in most cases), we also feature the Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos PC game which is our newest addition to our game roster. When we feature that game, we play the popular Duel Monsters trading card game against several characters from the franchise that some of you may remember. Characters such as Yugi Motou, Seto Kaiba, Joey Wheeler, Jaden Yuki, Yusei Fudo, Yuma Tsukumo, & Yuya Sakaki. This game as it's own live show is currently set to replace Roblox, which will conclude at the end of this year. When we feature Bigjon's Wheel of Fortune, we also feature a new segment of it which we introduced last year called "The Random Character Extravaganza". It's Wheel of Fortune but instead of just letters, it symbols and numbers that are the puzzles. It actually accidently began when I pushed the wrong key during one of the games, and then tried it out more and more afterward.
**Notice about live shows**
Each live show we try to start at the designated start time. If there are circumstances where we cannot do the show on time or at all, updates regarding said show will be listed in the Programming Updates section. Missed any of our live shows? We have on-demand replays of them on our YouTube channel so you can look back at it in it's entirety, or just your favorite moments.
**History**
It was launched in July 2021, rebroadcasting severe weather event timelines and only ran for certain hours of the day. When original programming was introduced to the main channel, severe weather event archives stopped airing in favor of the all original programming format. We went 24/7 in August 2025, now airing reruns of all original programming when live programs were not airing. During the weekend, it aired a weatherscan like segment that we call the “Plainfield TV Information Center”, interchanging the weatherscan name and that at times. It did so until March 16, 2026, as those operations are now exclusive to the Weatherscan Network.

Computer: Dell Optiplex 3060 Micro
Processor: Intel Core i5-8500T at 2.1 GHz
RAM: 32 GB (2x16 GB at 2666 MHz)
Storage 3 TB (1 TB SSD & 2 TB HDD (Stores programming)
OS: Windows 11 Pro 25H2

programme.title: Highland Weather 24/7 Monitoring - LIVE Forecasts & Alerts
programme.desc:
HIGHLAND WEATHER - 24/7 LIVE SEVERE WEATHER MONITORING: Welcome to your 24/7 watch on severe weather across the Western Carolina's, Northeast Georgia, and 3 counties in East TN. Our automated system keeps you ahead of the storm with real-time tracking, and instant warning notifications.
If needed, the automated system will be removed and the Highland Weather Team will be live on-air covering the warning until it expires. If not, our automated system will take over.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
❓ WHAT'S SHOWN ON THE STREAM? Our automated system is always monitoring the Western Carolina's, Northeast Georgia, & 3 counties in East Tennessee, and will announce: • New Weather Warnings: Tornado warnings are given top priority and announced immediately. All other weather alerts are shown through the entire cycle. • Priority Updates: We constantly cycle through the most critical warnings to keep you informed. Severe Thunderstorm, Tornado, & Flash Flood Warnings will make the text-to-speech voice come on-air, automatically covering the warnings until they expire.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
📈 OUR WEATHER SCORES: HWIS (LIVE) REMEMBER: Highland Weather's Index scores are internal tools designed for our team's operations. While interesting to follow, they should NEVER replace official weather warnings or local forecasts for your safety decisions.
➤ HIGHLAND WEATHER WEATHER INDEX SCORE (HWIS) - "What's Happening NOW" The HWIS is our real-time tool that tells the Highland Weather team when to go live and where weather is most impactful right now. Best for: Knowing when we might go live and following along with real-time local weather developments. • 0-30: Mostly Quiet - Minimal • 30-50: Some Activity - Team monitoring • 50-70: Notable Weather - Standby mode likely • 70-100: Significant Events - Team often going live • 100-150: Multiple Areas Impacted - Full team coverage mode • 150-250: Major Outbreak - All hands on deck • 250-350: Extreme Event - Continuous live coverage • 350+: Potentially Historic - Event (scores above 500 have occurred) ***THIS IS IN BETA MODE, AND MAY NOT BE ACCURATE AT TIMES***
ALWAYS RELY ON ALERTS FOR THE LATEST!
WAYS TO SUPPORT: https://www.patreon.com/c/HighlandWeather/home
SUBSCRIBE TO OUR CHANNELS: Beckett Webb: https://www.youtube.com/@UCmU4xcX8Vn050I7qLyXxKRA Asheville Flight Network: https://www.youtube.com/@UCfh0IxP9J4v-o_1Es8ZqB7g
FOLLOW HIGHLAND WEATHER ON SOCIAL MEDIA: • X/Twitter: https://x.com/HighlandWX • Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HIGHLANDWEATHERTV/ • Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/highlandweathertv/ • TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@highlandweather • Rumble: https://rumble.com/user/HighlandWeather?e9s=src_v1_sa%2Csrc_v3_sa_o • KICK: https://kick.com/highlandweather • Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/highlandweather • National Weather Network: https://nationalweathernetwork.com/organization/highland-weather-television-network • Website: https://sites.google.com/view/highlandwx/home

programme.desc:
Come and watch the Australian version of Weatherscan! Experience continuously updated Australian weather information with a redesigned interface, improved presentation, and convenient unit conversions designed specifically for Australian viewers.
Weatherscan Australia brings together current weather conditions, forecasts, radar information, and other useful weather data into an easy-to-follow television-style experience. Whether you're checking the weather before heading out or just want to keep an eye on conditions across Queensland, Weatherscan Australia aims to provide a simple and familiar way to stay informed.
The service is currently in development, with new features, improvements, and updates being added over time. Some information, graphics, or features may change as development continues.
NOTE: Weatherscan Australia is in development and may not be accurate in some cases! Weather information should not be relied upon for safety-critical decisions. Always check [official weather information](https://reg.bom.gov.au) when necessary.
For service announcements, updates, and important notices, visit the:
[TEIO Digital Cable Notice Board](https://wxscan.elliotd.au/notices)
